name: lifecycle_repair_bad_step_ref
why: Fix leg: a playbook that ran but misbehaved; the analyst asks to find and fix the defect. Inherits the framework's authoritative repair_bad_step_ref task (prompt + ir_assertions + broken YAML) so grading cannot drift from the eval matrix. Grades the CORRECTED canvas (does-it-run + the fix present + no collateral damage), not whether a diagnostic tool was merely reached.
